Detailed Description

template<class TrigXFadeEventType, class OwnerType = void>
class TrigXFade< TrigXFadeEventType, OwnerType >

Crossfade events using a trigger.

Creates a series of cross faded sounds from a user event class. The user event class should return a graph of unit generators from its spawnEvent() method that produce a continuous sound.

The trig input will cause a new event to be started and the old one to be faded out. TrigXFadeTexture will apply an envelope to the sound to cross fade different invocations of the event instance. This is different from Spawn which requires the envelope to be specified by the user.

See also:
TrigXFadeEventBase<OwnerType>, Spawn, TSpawn, XFadeTexture
